figurative_meaning_en: An inactive, lazy, indolent person with a dull intellect
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে জড়ভরতের মতো সারাদিন শুয়ে থাকে।
এই জড়ভরত অবস্থা ছেড়ে উঠে কাজ করো।
example_sentences_in_english: He lounges around like a lump all day.
Get out of this inert state and start working.
note: Refers to a state of complete inertia, common in colloquial Bengali to chide laziness.
